metadata.name: SBP Internet Banking Framework
metadata.description: The State Bank of Pakistan Regulations for the Security of Internet Banking, issued by the Payment Systems Department, provides a mandatory security framework for all banks in Pakistan offering internet banking services.
metadata.source_organization: State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) - Payment Systems Department
metadata.classification_reasoning: The SBP Regulations for the Security of Internet Banking is a mandatory regulatory framework issued by the State Bank of Pakistan for all banks in Pakistan offering internet banking services. Compliance is monitored through SBP supervision and reporting requirements.
metadata.framework_purpose: To help banks in Pakistan develop a formal Internet Banking Security Framework containing administrative, technical and physical safeguards based on best international practices, protecting against financial and reputational risks arising from IT security breaches.
metadata.framework_scope: All banks in Pakistan providing financial and/or non-financial transactions through internet, irrespective of software tool used by the bank and access devices used by its customers.
framework_objectives: Ensure security and integrity of data and systems so that customers' information has not been modified and systems are free from unauthorized access
Ensure confidentiality of customers' data in storage, during processing and in transit
Ensure reliability and availability of Internet Banking systems to provide prompt access to registered users and maintain operational effectiveness
Ensure accountability by designing SOPs, policies and controls to ensure traceability of all transactions
Adopt a proactive approach to detect unauthorized access and identify potential fraudulent transactions
metadata.target_audience: Board of Directors, Senior Management, IT Security Teams, Digital Banking Teams, Fraud Prevention Teams, and Compliance Officers of all SBP-regulated banks offering internet banking
required_artifacts: Internet Banking Security Framework document (BOD approved)
Security Risk Assessment document (reviewed by BOD, at least annually)
Quarterly Security Breach Reports to Payment Systems Department (Annexure-I)
metadata.regulatory_authority: State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) - Payment Systems Department
metadata.penalty_for_non_compliance: Non-compliance may result in regulatory penalties, restrictions on internet banking services, and enforcement actions as per SBP regulations.
metadata.adoption_approach: Risk-based implementation with mandatory compliance for all banks providing internet banking services in Pakistan.

controls.title: Internet Banking Security Framework
controls.description: Bank shall develop, implement and regularly review an Internet Banking Security Framework based on defined security objectives. The framework must be approved by BODs, clearly define roles and responsibilities, and include Security Risk Assessment, Security Controls Implementation and Security Controls Monitoring.
controls.full_text: Bank shall develop, implement and regularly review Internet Banking Security Framework based on the following key security objectives: a) Security and integrity of data and systems, to ensure that customers' information has not been modified and systems are free from unauthorized access; b) Confidentiality of customers' data in storage, during processing and in transit; c) Reliability and availability of Internet Banking systems to provide prompt access to systems for registered users and maintaining operational effectiveness; d) Accountability by designing SOPs, policies and controls to ensure traceability of all transactions; e) Proactive approach to detect unauthorized access and identification of potential fraudulent transactions. While developing the Internet Banking Security Framework the bank should take into account the complexity of systems, applications and products/services offered while at the same time ensuring the ease of usage and customers' convenience. Further the framework should clearly define the roles and responsibilities of Board of Directors (BODs), senior management and employees with regard to its approval, development and implementation. This Framework and any reviews thereafter should be duly approved by the BODs. The Internet Banking Security Framework shall include the following components: Security Risk Assessment, Implementation of Security Controls and Monitoring of Security Controls.

controls.title: Security Objective: Security and Integrity of Data and Systems
controls.description: The Internet Banking Security Framework shall ensure security and integrity of data and systems, ensuring that customers' information has not been modified and systems are free from unauthorized access.
controls.full_text: Security and integrity of data and systems, to ensure that customers' information has not been modified and systems are free from unauthorized access.

controls.title: Security Objective: Confidentiality of Customers' Data

controls.full_text: Reliability and availability of Internet Banking systems to provide prompt access to systems for registered users and maintaining operational effectiveness.

evidence_requirements.name: IB Availability SLA Document
evidence_requirements.description: Documented availability target/SLA for the IB platform (e.g., 99.9%) with measurement methodology and exclusions.

evidence_requirements.name: Uptime Monitoring Dashboard Export

evidence_requirements.name: Operational Effectiveness Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic operational effectiveness reports covering IB transaction success rates, response times and error rates.

evidence_requirements.name: HA / Redundancy Architecture Diagram
evidence_requirements.description: Architecture diagram showing High Availability and redundancy design for the IB platform across active-active or active-passive sites.

evidence_requirements.name: Capacity Management Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic capacity management reports demonstrating headroom against forecasted IB load.

controls.title: Security Objective: Accountability and Traceability
controls.description: The Internet Banking Security Framework shall ensure accountability by designing SOPs, policies and controls to ensure traceability of all transactions.
controls.full_text: Accountability by designing SOPs, policies and controls to ensure traceability of all transactions.

evidence_requirements.description: Standard Operating Procedure for end-to-end traceability of every IB transaction from origin (customer device/IP) to settlement, including correlation IDs.

evidence_requirements.name: Audit Trail Policy

evidence_requirements.name: Non-Repudiation Controls Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Documentation of non-repudiation controls (digital signatures on transactions, signed OTP verifications) supporting accountability.

controls.title: Security Objective: Proactive Fraud Detection

controls.full_text: Proactive approach to detect unauthorized access and identification of potential fraudulent transactions.

controls.title: Security Risk Assessment
controls.description: The bank shall conduct and document a formal Security Risk Assessment for Internet Banking to identify, estimate and prioritize risks. BODs shall review the risk assessment and any subsequent reviews. The assessment shall be reviewed at least annually and immediately after a major security breach, significant infrastructure change, or introduction of a new product or service.
controls.full_text: The bank shall conduct and document a formal Security Risk Assessment for Internet Banking with a view of identifying, estimating and prioritizing risks to which its operations are exposed due to Internet Banking. The BODs should review the risk assessment document and any reviews conducted thereafter. The Security Risk Assessment should be reviewed at least once a year; however, in case of a major security breach, significant changes to the infrastructure and introduction of a new product or service, an immediate review of risk assessment should be carried out. Further, in case of a major security breach, risk assessment review should include a detailed analysis of the factors that cause such security breaches.

evidence_requirements.description: Comprehensive Security Risk Assessment for Internet Banking identifying, estimating and prioritising risks to bank operations.

evidence_requirements.name: BoD Review Minutes — Risk Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Board of Directors meeting minutes recording review of the IB Security Risk Assessment and any subsequent updates.

controls.full_text: A current and detailed description of bank's business and technology environment and existing security measures in place including identification of location, systems and methods for maintaining customers' information.

evidence_requirements.name: Existing Security Measures Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Inventory of existing security measures (firewalls, WAF, IDS/IPS, MFA, DLP, EDR, SIEM) deployed in support of IB.

evidence_requirements.name: Customer Information Location & Methods Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register identifying physical and logical locations, systems and methods for maintaining customer information (primary, replicas, backups, archives).

controls.title: Identification of Information and Information Systems to be Protected
controls.description: The Security Risk Assessment shall include identification of information and the information systems to be protected.
controls.full_text: An identification of information and the information systems to be protected.

evidence_requirements.name: Information Asset Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Inventory of all information assets in scope of Internet Banking with owner, custodian, classification and protection requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: Information Systems Inventory (CMDB Extract)
evidence_requirements.description: CMDB extract listing every information system supporting IB (servers, databases, middleware, network devices, security appliances).

evidence_requirements.name: Asset-to-Service Mapping
evidence_requirements.description: Mapping of each IB service/product to its underlying information assets and systems.

controls.title: Classification and Ranking of Sensitive Systems and Data
controls.description: The Security Risk Assessment shall include classification and ranking (high, medium, low) of sensitive systems, payment data and applications in order of importance based on assessment of threats and vulnerabilities.
controls.full_text: Classification and ranking (high, medium, low) of the sensitive systems, payment data and applications in order of their importance and based on the assessment of threats and vulnerabilities.

evidence_requirements.name: Information Classification Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Approved classification policy defining High / Medium / Low criteria for sensitive systems, payment data and applications.

evidence_requirements.name: Classification Ranking Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register classifying each sensitive system, payment data set and application as High / Medium / Low with threat/vulnerability rationale.

evidence_requirements.name: Classification Methodology Document
evidence_requirements.description: Methodology used to derive classifications including importance criteria, threat factors and vulnerability factors.

evidence_requirements.name: Periodic Classification Review Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of periodic review and re-classification by data/system owners.

controls.title: Assessment of Threats and Vulnerabilities
controls.description: The Security Risk Assessment shall include assessment of potential threats and vulnerabilities to the security and integrity of customers' information, payments data, IT systems and applications.
controls.full_text: Assessment of potential threats and vulnerabilities to security and integrity of customers' information, payments data, IT systems and applications.

evidence_requirements.name: IB Threat Assessment Report
evidence_requirements.description: Threat assessment report covering customer information, payments data, IT systems and applications — including threat actors, attack vectors and likelihood.

evidence_requirements.name: Vulnerability Assessment Report
evidence_requirements.description: Latest vulnerability assessment report (Qualys / Tenable / Nessus / Rapid7) covering IB infrastructure and applications.

evidence_requirements.name: Threat Intelligence Feed Subscriptions
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of threat intelligence feed subscriptions (commercial / FS-ISAC / CERT-PK) feeding the threat assessment.

evidence_requirements.name: Threat-to-Asset Mapping Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: Matrix mapping each identified threat/vulnerability to affected assets (customer information, payments data, IT systems, applications).

controls.title: Assessment of Identity Theft and Identity Fraud Risks
controls.description: The Security Risk Assessment shall include assessment of risks related to identity theft and identity fraud.
controls.full_text: Assessment of risks related to identity theft and identity fraud.

evidence_requirements.name: Identity Theft Risk Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Documented assessment of identity theft risks specific to IB (account takeover, SIM swap, phishing, social engineering, credential stuffing).

evidence_requirements.name: Identity Fraud Risk Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Documented assessment of identity fraud risks (synthetic identity, mule accounts, document forgery in onboarding).

evidence_requirements.name: Identity Fraud Loss Statistics
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic identity fraud loss statistics with trends, categories and lessons learned.

evidence_requirements.name: Identity Fraud Treatment Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Treatment plan listing controls implemented or planned to mitigate identity theft / fraud risks (KYC enhancements, device binding, behavioural biometrics).

controls.title: Evaluation of Existing Security Controls Effectiveness
controls.description: The Security Risk Assessment shall include an evaluation of existing Security Controls' effectiveness against each identified threat and vulnerability.
controls.full_text: An evaluation of existing Security Controls' effectiveness against each threat and vulnerability.

evidence_requirements.name: Control Effectiveness Evaluation Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: Matrix evaluating effectiveness of each existing Security Control against each identified threat and vulnerability with rating (Effective / Partially / Ineffective).

evidence_requirements.name: Control Testing Results
evidence_requirements.description: Results of control testing exercises (purple team, breach-and-attack simulation, MITRE ATT&CK alignment tests) supporting effectiveness ratings.

evidence_requirements.name: Residual Risk Register
evidence_requirements.description: Residual risk register showing residual risk after applying existing controls with treatment decisions.

evidence_requirements.name: Control Gap Analysis Report
evidence_requirements.description: Gap analysis report identifying control deficiencies and recommended enhancements.

controls.title: Service Providers Security and Contractual Responsibilities
controls.description: The Security Risk Assessment shall address the security and contractual responsibilities of Service Providers (SPs), including customers who have access to the bank's systems and data.
controls.full_text: The security and contractual responsibilities of Service Providers (SPs), including customers who have access to the bank's systems and data.

evidence_requirements.name: Service Provider Inventory (IB Scope)
evidence_requirements.description: Inventory of all Service Providers supporting IB with services, criticality and access scope.

evidence_requirements.name: SP Security & Contractual Responsibility Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: Matrix documenting security and contractual responsibilities of each Service Provider including customers with system/data access.

evidence_requirements.name: Executed SP Contracts with Security Clauses
evidence_requirements.description: Sample executed Service Provider contracts highlighting security obligations and clauses.

evidence_requirements.name: Customer System-Access Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Inventory of customer entities (e.g., corporate customers) with access to bank systems/data with access rationale and controls.

controls.title: Outsourcing Risk Assessment
controls.description: Risks including Compliance, Concentration, Operational, Country and Legal should be assessed by the banks before entering and while managing Internet Banking outsourcing arrangements with Service Providers.
controls.full_text: Risks like Compliance, Concentration, Operational, Country and Legal should be assessed by the banks before entering and while managing Internet Banking outsourcing arrangements with the SPs.

evidence_requirements.name: Pre-Engagement Outsourcing Risk Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Pre-engagement risk assessment for each Service Provider covering Compliance, Concentration, Operational, Country and Legal risks.

evidence_requirements.name: Ongoing Outsourcing Risk Reviews
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic ongoing risk review reports for active outsourcing arrangements.

evidence_requirements.name: Concentration Risk Analysis
evidence_requirements.description: Concentration risk analysis identifying SP dependency hotspots in IB and mitigation actions.

evidence_requirements.name: Country Risk Assessment for Offshore SPs
evidence_requirements.description: Country risk assessment for any offshore Service Providers covering political, legal and regulatory dimensions.

evidence_requirements.name: Outsourcing Risk Register
evidence_requirements.description: Outsourcing risk register tracking all risk types per SP with treatment status.

controls.title: Legal Environment Risk Assessment
controls.description: The Security Risk Assessment shall address risks related to the legal environment and the bank's responsibilities under Section 32, Section 41, Section 43, Section 70 and other relevant provisions of the Payment Systems and Electronic Fund Transfers Act 2007.
controls.full_text: Risk Assessment related to legal environment and bank's responsibilities under Section 32 (Availability of Documentation and Proof), section 41 (Burden of Proof), Section 43 (Liability of banks/Authorized Parties), section 70 (Secrecy and Privacy) and other relevant provisions of the Payment Systems and Electronic Fund Transfers Act 2007.

evidence_requirements.name: Legal Environment Risk Assessment Report
evidence_requirements.description: Risk assessment report explicitly referencing the Payment Systems and Electronic Fund Transfers Act 2007 and bank responsibilities thereunder.

evidence_requirements.name: Section 32 Compliance Assessment (Documentation & Proof)
evidence_requirements.description: Assessment of bank's compliance with Section 32 (Availability of Documentation and Proof) — retention, retrieval and admissibility of IB transaction records.

evidence_requirements.name: Section 41 Compliance Assessment (Burden of Proof)
evidence_requirements.description: Assessment of bank's compliance with Section 41 (Burden of Proof) — record-keeping practices that support discharge of burden of proof in disputes.

evidence_requirements.name: Section 43 Compliance Assessment (Liability)
evidence_requirements.description: Assessment of bank's compliance with Section 43 (Liability of banks/Authorized Parties) — liability allocation, customer indemnity processes and dispute handling.

evidence_requirements.name: Section 70 Compliance Assessment (Secrecy & Privacy)
evidence_requirements.description: Assessment of bank's compliance with Section 70 (Secrecy and Privacy) — confidentiality of customer information and lawful disclosure procedures.

evidence_requirements.name: Legal Function Sign-off
evidence_requirements.description: Legal function sign-off on the legal-environment risk assessment confirming completeness of statutory coverage.

controls.title: Security Controls Implementation
controls.description: The bank shall ensure appropriate security arrangements and security controls to protect IT assets are in place, developed based on the Security Risk Assessment and commensurate with risk levels. The bank shall define minimum baseline Security Controls covering Access Controls, Network Access Controls, Operating System Access Controls, Application Access and Remote Access Controls.
controls.full_text: The bank shall ensure that appropriate security arrangements and security controls to protect IT assets (such as systems, applications, networks, data, and information and communication systems) are in place. Bank shall develop a set of controls based on the Security Risk Assessment document, commensurate with the risk levels to meet the control objectives. Bank shall define its set of minimum baseline Security Controls that include Access Controls (Access Rights Management, Electronic Authentication etc), Network Access Controls, Operating System Access Controls, Application Access and Remote Access Controls.

evidence_requirements.name: Minimum Baseline Security Controls Standard
evidence_requirements.description: Approved minimum baseline security controls standard for IB covering Access, Network, Operating System, Application and Remote Access controls.

evidence_requirements.name: Risk-to-Control Mapping
evidence_requirements.description: Mapping demonstrating that controls in the baseline are derived from Security Risk Assessment findings and are commensurate with risk levels.

evidence_requirements.name: Access Rights Management Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure governing user access lifecycle (joiners, movers, leavers) for IB systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Electronic Authentication Standard
evidence_requirements.description: Standard governing electronic authentication mechanisms used for staff and customer access to IB systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Network Access Control Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration export of NACs (802.1X / NAC appliance / cloud network policies) protecting IB infrastructure.

evidence_requirements.name: Operating System Access Control Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: OS access control configuration (sudoers, GPO, RBAC) for IB servers.

evidence_requirements.name: Application Access Control Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Application-level access control configuration (RBAC, ABAC) for the IB application stack.

evidence_requirements.name: Remote Access Control Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Remote access controls (VPN, ZTNA, jump-host, PAM) configuration evidence for privileged access to IB.

controls.title: Authentication Controls
controls.description: Minimum authentication controls to be implemented by banks for Internet Banking customers, covering registration/enrollment, two-factor authentication, layered security for high-value transactions, account lockout and session controls, and periodic authentication risk assessment.
controls.full_text: Minimum Security Controls to be implemented by banks should include the following aspects under Authentication Controls.

evidence_requirements.name: Customer Authentication Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Approved authentication policy for IB customers covering enrollment, 2FA, layered security, account lockout, session timeout and re-authentication.

evidence_requirements.name: Authentication Architecture Document

evidence_requirements.name: Authentication Controls Implementation Matrix

controls.title: Customer Registration and Enrollment

controls.full_text: Registration/enrollment for Internet Banking customers should be done prior to offering Internet Banking products and services after due verification through appropriate means.

evidence_requirements.description: Documented procedure for IB customer registration/enrollment specifying verification steps performed prior to granting access.

evidence_requirements.name: Identity Verification Workflow Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Workflow/screenshots showing identity verification (CNIC, biometric/NADRA verisys, OTP, branch confirmation) executed during enrollment.

evidence_requirements.name: Enrollment Audit Log Sample
evidence_requirements.description: Sample audit log of customer enrollments showing verification method, timestamp, agent and outcome.

evidence_requirements.name: Pre-Activation Hold Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence that IB products/services are activated only after successful verification (system configuration showing pre-activation hold logic).

controls.title: Two Factor Authentication (2FA)
controls.description: In order to authenticate customers who use Internet Banking products and services the bank shall implement at least Two Factor Authentication (2FA) such as Passwords (1st factor) and One time tokens, Dongles etc (2nd factor).
controls.full_text: In order to authenticate customers who use Internet Banking products and services the bank shall implement at least Two Factor Authentication (2FA) such as Passwords (1 factor) and One time tokens, Dongles etc (2nd factor).

evidence_requirements.name: 2FA Policy

evidence_requirements.name: 2FA Method Inventory

evidence_requirements.name: Login & Transaction 2FA Workflow Screenshots
evidence_requirements.description: Screenshots of IB customer login and transaction-approval flows demonstrating 2FA prompts.

evidence_requirements.name: 2FA Coverage Audit
evidence_requirements.description: Audit/report confirming 100% of customer authentication paths require 2FA with no bypass routes.

controls.title: Layered Security for High Value Transactions
controls.description: Bank shall implement additional layered security programs for high value transactions processed through Internet Banking.
controls.full_text: Bank shall implement additional layered security programs for high value transactions processed through Internet Banking.

evidence_requirements.name: High-Value Transaction Threshold Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Approved policy defining high-value transaction thresholds and the additional layered security required.

controls.full_text: Authentication controls should also take into account failed log-in attempts, frequency of password changes, session time outs and re-authentication of customers based on predefined criteria.

controls.full_text: Bank shall conduct periodic risk assessment of authentication controls to identify threats and vulnerabilities based on changes in applications' functionality, threats due to changes in internal and external environment, changes in customers' preferences and actual security breaches.

controls.full_text: The following controls shall apply on bank employees who are users of Internet Banking related systems.

evidence_requirements.name: In-House Security Controls Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Consolidated policy covering all in-house security controls applicable to bank employees who use IB-related systems (sub-controls a–k).

evidence_requirements.name: In-House Controls Coverage Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: Matrix mapping each sub-control (2.2.2(a)–(k)) to implemented controls, owners and review status.

controls.title: Access Rights Management
controls.description: Users' access rights should be appropriate and commensurate with their job functions, periodically reviewed per risk ranking from the Security Risk Assessment, and changes applied only after due authorization, ensuring proper implementation of Least Privilege Principle.
controls.full_text: Access Rights Management: Users' access rights should be appropriate and commensurate with their job functions and should be periodically reviewed keeping in view the risk ranking of the systems, data and applications as outlined in Security Risk Assessment document. Changes in Access Rights should be based on personal or systems change and should only be applied after due authorization while ensuring proper implementation of 'Least Privilege Principle'.

evidence_requirements.name: Least Privilege Access Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Approved access rights policy implementing the Least Privilege Principle for IB-related systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Role-Based Access Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: RBAC matrix mapping job functions to access rights on IB systems with approver designations.

evidence_requirements.name: Periodic Access Review Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic user access review reports (quarterly/half-yearly) prioritised by risk ranking from the Security Risk Assessment.

evidence_requirements.name: Access Change Authorization Records
evidence_requirements.description: Sample access change authorisation records (joiner/mover/leaver, change tickets) with approver sign-off.

evidence_requirements.name: Risk-Ranked Review Schedule
evidence_requirements.description: Schedule showing review cadence for high/medium/low risk systems aligned with Risk Assessment classifications.

evidence_requirements.name: SoD Conflict Analysis
evidence_requirements.description: Segregation-of-Duties conflict analysis report for IB-related access rights with mitigation actions.

controls.title: Operating Systems Controls
controls.description: Necessary Operating Systems' controls should be implemented to ensure access is physically and logically secured, with privileged access restricted, regularly monitored and periodically audited.
controls.full_text: Operating Systems Controls: Necessary Operating Systems' controls should be implemented to ensure that access is physically and logically secured by ensuring that privileged access is restricted, regularly monitored and periodically audited.

evidence_requirements.name: OS Hardening Standard
evidence_requirements.description: Documented OS hardening standard (CIS Benchmarks aligned) for IB servers covering Windows, Linux/Unix.

evidence_requirements.name: OS Hardening Compliance Report
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration compliance report from hardening tool (CIS-CAT, Defender for Cloud, Qualys Policy Compliance) for IB OS instances.

evidence_requirements.name: Privileged Access Management Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: PAM tool configuration (CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea) for privileged OS accounts on IB systems with vaulting and session recording.

evidence_requirements.name: Privileged Session Recording Sample
evidence_requirements.description: Sample privileged session recordings from PAM tool for IB OS administration activities.

evidence_requirements.name: Periodic Privileged Access Audit Report
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic audit report on privileged access to IB OS systems with findings and closures.

evidence_requirements.name: Physical OS Access Controls Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of physical access controls protecting OS consoles in data centres (rack locks, cabinet biometrics).

controls.title: Remote Access
controls.description: Remote access to high risk IT assets shall only be granted after management's written approval, shall be subject to regular audits, and shall be based on strong authentication and encryption to secure communications.
controls.full_text: Remote Access: Remote access to high risk IT assets shall only be granted after management's approval in writing and should be subject to regular audits. Remote access shall also be based on strong authentication and encryption to secure communications.

evidence_requirements.name: Remote Access Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Approved remote access policy specifying written-approval requirement, strong authentication and encryption obligations for high-risk IT assets.

evidence_requirements.name: Remote Access Approval Records
evidence_requirements.description: Sample written management approvals (signed forms / ticketed approvals) for remote access to high-risk IB IT assets.

evidence_requirements.name: Remote Access Audit Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Regular audit reports on remote access to high-risk IT assets (frequency, users, sessions, anomalies).

evidence_requirements.name: Strong Authentication Configuration (Remote)
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration evidence of MFA enforced for remote access (VPN, ZTNA, jump host).

evidence_requirements.name: Remote Access Encryption Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration evidence of encrypted remote access protocols (TLS 1.2+/1.3, IPSec, SSH ciphers) with prohibited weak protocols disabled.

evidence_requirements.name: Remote Access Session Logs
evidence_requirements.description: Sample logs from VPN/ZTNA/PAM showing remote access sessions to high-risk IB assets.

controls.title: Physical Access
controls.description: Banks shall ensure that physical access to different systems, segments and data sites is restricted, regularly monitored and duly logged.
controls.full_text: Physical Access: Banks shall ensure that physical access to different systems, segments and data sites is restricted, regularly monitored and duly logged.

evidence_requirements.name: Physical Access Control Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Approved physical access control policy covering data centres, server rooms and segments hosting IB systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Authorised Access List
evidence_requirements.description: List of personnel authorised for physical access to data sites with role, justification and review date.

evidence_requirements.name: Physical Access Logs
evidence_requirements.description: Physical access logs (badge swipes, biometric reader logs) for data centre and server-room entries.

evidence_requirements.name: CCTV Coverage Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of CCTV coverage and retention for data centre / server-room areas hosting IB infrastructure.

evidence_requirements.name: Physical Access Monitoring Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic monitoring reports of physical access events with anomaly investigation.

evidence_requirements.name: Visitor Management Records
evidence_requirements.description: Visitor management records for data sites including escort, purpose and time.

controls.title: IT Network Security
controls.description: IT networks shall be secured through the use of multiple layers of controls.
controls.full_text: IT Network Security: IT networks shall be secured through the use of multiple layers of controls.

evidence_requirements.name: Network Security Architecture
evidence_requirements.description: Defense-in-depth network security architecture document covering perimeter, DMZ, internal segmentation, micro-segmentation and east-west controls for IB.

evidence_requirements.name: Network Topology Diagram
evidence_requirements.description: Current-state network topology diagram showing multiple security control layers protecting IB.

evidence_requirements.name: Network Control Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Inventory of network controls (firewall, IDS/IPS, WAF, NAC, NDR, DDoS, secure DNS, proxy) with ownership and coverage.

evidence_requirements.name: Network Segmentation Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration evidence of network segmentation between zones (Internet, DMZ, App, DB, Mgmt) restricting lateral movement.

evidence_requirements.name: Network Security Validation Report
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic validation report (segmentation test, attack simulation) confirming layered controls function as designed.

controls.title: Firewalls
controls.description: Firewalls shall be deployed between different security domains to control network traffic. Firewall selection and deployment policy should be devised according to the characteristics of the network including traffic volume and risk classification of IT assets.
controls.full_text: Firewalls: Firewalls shall be deployed between different security domains to control network traffic. Firewalls selection and deployment policy should be devised according to the characteristics of network (i.e. traffic volume, and risk classification of IT assets).

evidence_requirements.name: Firewall Selection & Deployment Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Approved firewall selection and deployment policy referencing network traffic volume and IT asset risk classification.

evidence_requirements.name: Firewall Deployment Architecture
evidence_requirements.description: Architecture diagram showing firewalls deployed between every pair of distinct security domains (Internet/DMZ/App/DB/Mgmt).

evidence_requirements.name: Firewall Configuration / Rule Base Export
evidence_requirements.description: Firewall rule base export (sanitized) for IB-protecting firewalls with rule justifications.

evidence_requirements.name: Firewall Rule Review Records
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic firewall rule review records identifying redundant, shadowed or overly-permissive rules.

evidence_requirements.name: Firewall Capacity & Performance Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Capacity and performance reports demonstrating firewall sizing matches traffic volume.

controls.title: IDS/IPS Deployment
controls.description: Network Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) and Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS) should be deployed between different security domains as per their risk classification.
controls.full_text: IDS/IPS: Network Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) and Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS) should be deployed between different security domains as per their risk classification.

evidence_requirements.name: IDS/IPS Deployment Architecture
evidence_requirements.description: Architecture diagram showing IDS/IPS sensors deployed at boundaries between security domains aligned to risk classifications.

evidence_requirements.name: IDS/IPS Configuration Export
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration export of IDS/IPS sensors with active signature sets, detection mode (IDS vs IPS) and tuning.

evidence_requirements.name: IDS/IPS Signature Update Logs
evidence_requirements.description: Signature update logs evidencing currency of detection capabilities.

evidence_requirements.name: Sample IDS/IPS Alerts
evidence_requirements.description: Sample IDS/IPS alerts with triage and disposition records.

evidence_requirements.name: IDS/IPS Coverage Validation
evidence_requirements.description: Validation report confirming all required security-domain boundaries have appropriate IDS/IPS coverage.

controls.title: Identity Theft Prevention Program
controls.description: Bank shall develop and implement a proactive Identity Theft Prevention Program which includes procedures for identification of information to be protected, threats due to thefts and frauds, and methods for responding appropriately to identified threats.
controls.full_text: Identity Theft Prevention: Bank shall develop and implement a proactive Identity Theft Prevention Program which includes procedures for identification of information to be protected, and threats due to thefts and frauds as well as methods for responding appropriately to identified threats.

evidence_requirements.name: Identity Theft Prevention Program
evidence_requirements.description: Approved Identity Theft Prevention Program document covering identification of protected information, theft/fraud threats and response methods.

evidence_requirements.name: Protected Information Identification Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure for identifying information to be protected from identity theft (CNIC, account numbers, OTPs, biometric templates, security questions).

evidence_requirements.name: Identity Theft Threat Catalogue
evidence_requirements.description: Catalogue of identity theft and fraud threats considered (account takeover, SIM swap, credential stuffing, phishing, smishing, vishing, deepfake voice).

evidence_requirements.name: Identity Theft Response Playbook
evidence_requirements.description: Response playbook detailing methods for responding to identified identity theft threats (account block, customer notification, law enforcement liaison).

evidence_requirements.name: Identity Theft Detection Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration of detection rules (UEBA, fraud monitoring) supporting proactive identification of identity theft attempts.

evidence_requirements.name: Identity Theft Case Statistics
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic statistics of identified identity theft cases, response times and outcomes.

controls.title: Encryption
controls.description: Access, storage and data communication shall be encrypted using reliable encryption methods to strengthen the security of communications and sensitive payment data.
controls.full_text: Encryption: Access, storage and data communication shall be encrypted using reliable encryption methods to strengthen the security of communications and sensitive payment data.

evidence_requirements.name: Cryptographic Standard
evidence_requirements.description: Approved cryptographic standard listing reliable algorithms (AES-256, RSA-2048+, ECDSA, TLS 1.2+/1.3) and prohibiting obsolete ones (DES, 3DES, RC4, MD5, SHA-1).

evidence_requirements.name: Access Encryption Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration evidence that all access channels (admin and customer) use encrypted protocols.

evidence_requirements.name: Storage Encryption Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration export showing encryption-at-rest enabled on databases, file stores, backups and removable media for IB.

evidence_requirements.name: Data-in-Transit Encryption Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration of TLS for all IB data-in-transit (customer-facing, server-to-server, integration APIs) with cipher suite hardening.

evidence_requirements.name: Sensitive Payment Data Encryption Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Specific evidence of encryption applied to sensitive payment data (PAN, OTP, account numbers) including tokenisation where applicable.

evidence_requirements.name: Key Management Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Key management procedure covering generation, distribution, storage, rotation and destruction of cryptographic keys.

controls.title: Traceability
controls.description: Bank shall maintain the traceability of transactions executed to discharge their obligations under the relevant sections of the Payment Systems and Electronic Fund Transfers Act 2007.
controls.full_text: Traceability: Bank shall maintain the traceability of transactions executed to discharge their obligations under the relevant sections of Payment Systems and Electronic Fund Transfers Act 2007.

evidence_requirements.name: Transaction Traceability Standard
evidence_requirements.description: Standard specifying mandatory fields, retention and tamper-evident storage to discharge PS-EFT Act 2007 obligations.

evidence_requirements.name: End-to-End Transaction Audit Trail
evidence_requirements.description: Sample end-to-end transaction audit trail demonstrating traceability across customer device, IB application, core banking and settlement systems.

evidence_requirements.name: PS-EFT Act 2007 Obligation Mapping
evidence_requirements.description: Mapping of relevant PS-EFT Act 2007 sections to bank's traceability controls and audit trail capabilities.

evidence_requirements.name: Audit Trail Retention Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration evidence of audit trail retention period meeting PS-EFT Act 2007 requirements (and section 2.3(g) ten-year retention).

evidence_requirements.name: Tamper-Evident Storage Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of tamper-evident storage (WORM/immutable storage, hash-chained logs) for IB transaction audit trails.

controls.title: Employee Training
controls.description: Relevant bank employees shall have appropriate knowledge and background to perform their tasks. Regular trainings should be arranged to keep employees aware of security risks, security controls and monitoring mechanisms. Employees should be regularly updated about changes in internal policies and procedures to ensure operational effectiveness.
controls.full_text: Training: Relevant employees of the bank shall have appropriate knowledge and background to perform their tasks. Regular trainings should be arranged to keep employees aware of the security risks, security controls and security control monitoring mechanisms. Employees should be regularly updated about the changes in internal policies and procedures to ensure operational effectiveness.

evidence_requirements.name: Training Plan & Curriculum
evidence_requirements.description: Approved security training plan and curriculum for employees handling IB systems covering security risks, controls and monitoring mechanisms.

evidence_requirements.name: Role-Based Training Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: Matrix mapping IB-related job roles to mandatory training modules and refresher cadence.

evidence_requirements.name: Training Completion Records
evidence_requirements.description: LMS records evidencing training completion by relevant employees within required timeframes.

evidence_requirements.name: Knowledge & Background Verification
evidence_requirements.description: Records of verifying appropriate knowledge and background of employees through assessments or pre-hire screening.

evidence_requirements.name: Policy Update Communications
evidence_requirements.description: Communications/notifications to employees regarding changes in internal policies and procedures with acknowledgement records.

evidence_requirements.name: Training Effectiveness Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Post-training assessments and phishing-simulation results demonstrating training effectiveness.

controls.title: Security Controls Implementation for Outsourced Functions
controls.description: Service Providers of outsourced Internet Banking functions are contractually bound to implement these regulations. Outsourcing does not relieve the bank of its compliance responsibility. Banks shall ensure all controls in section 2.2.2 plus the additional outsourcing-specific controls are followed.
controls.full_text: Service Providers of outsourced functions relating to Internet Banking are contractually bounded to implement these regulations. However, outsourcing does not relieve the bank from its responsibility of complying with these regulations. Further bank shall ensure that in addition to security controls mentioned in section 2.2.2, the following security controls for outsourced functions are also followed.

evidence_requirements.name: Service Provider Master Contract Repository
evidence_requirements.description: Repository of executed Service Provider contracts containing clauses contractually binding SPs to implement SBP Internet Banking regulations.

evidence_requirements.name: Compliance Flow-Down Clause Sample
evidence_requirements.description: Sample SP contract clause flowing down all SBP IB regulation requirements (sections 2.2.2 and 2.2.3) to the Service Provider.

evidence_requirements.name: Bank Compliance Accountability Memo
evidence_requirements.description: Internal memo or policy clarifying that outsourcing does not relieve the bank of its compliance responsibility under these regulations.

evidence_requirements.name: SP Compliance Monitoring Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register tracking each Service Provider's compliance with SBP regulations including 2.2.2 controls and 2.2.3 sub-requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: SP Attestation Records
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic attestations from Service Providers confirming continued compliance with SBP IB regulations.

controls.title: Non-Disclosure and Right to Audit in Service Provider Contracts
controls.description: Contracts with Service Providers should include Non-Disclosure provisions to ensure confidentiality and security of bank and customers' information, and shall grant the bank as well as SBP the right to audit Service Providers' security controls.
controls.full_text: Contracts with Service Providers should be equipped with provision relating to Non Disclosure to ensure the confidentiality and security of bank and customers' information and to bank's as well as SBP's right to audit Service Providers' security controls as per the requirements set forth in these regulations.

evidence_requirements.name: Non-Disclosure Provisions in SP Contracts
evidence_requirements.description: Sample executed SP contracts highlighting NDA provisions covering bank and customer information.

evidence_requirements.name: Bank's Right-to-Audit Clause
evidence_requirements.description: Sample executed SP contracts containing the bank's contractual right to audit the SP's security controls.

evidence_requirements.name: SBP Right-to-Audit Clause
evidence_requirements.description: Sample executed SP contracts containing SBP's right to audit the SP's security controls.

evidence_requirements.name: Right-to-Audit Exercise Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of audit rights exercised on Service Providers (engagement letters, audit reports, findings).

evidence_requirements.name: Legal Vetting Sign-off
evidence_requirements.description: Legal function sign-off confirming all SP contracts contain compliant NDA and audit rights provisions.

controls.title: Customer Information Protection by Service Providers
controls.description: Appropriate measures to avoid any loss, theft or leakage of customers' information shall be developed and implemented by the Service Providers.
controls.full_text: Appropriate measures to avoid any loss, theft or leakage of customers' information are developed and implemented by the Service Providers.

evidence_requirements.name: SP Customer Information Protection Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Service Provider policies and procedures preventing loss, theft or leakage of customer information (DLP, encryption, access control).

evidence_requirements.name: SP Security Control Self-Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Service Provider self-assessment / questionnaire responses on customer information protection controls.

evidence_requirements.name: SP Independent Assurance Reports
evidence_requirements.description: SP-provided independent assurance reports (SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 / equivalent) covering customer information protection.

evidence_requirements.name: Bank Verification Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of bank's verification (audits, walk-throughs, control testing) that SPs have implemented appropriate measures.

evidence_requirements.name: SP Incident History
evidence_requirements.description: Register of any SP incidents involving customer information loss, theft or leakage with corrective actions.

controls.title: Controlled and Monitored Service Provider Access to Customer Information
controls.description: Service Providers' access to customer information shall be request-based, strictly monitored, logged and periodically audited. Customer information shall not be transferred to unauthorized storage or access medium.
controls.full_text: Service Providers' access to customer information is based on the request from the bank or the concerned customer and should be strictly monitored, logged and periodically audited. Further, customer information shall not be transferred to unauthorized storage or access medium.

evidence_requirements.name: Request-Based Access Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Documented procedure mandating request-based (bank or customer-initiated) access for Service Providers to customer information.

evidence_requirements.name: SP Access Request Records
evidence_requirements.description: Sample records of SP access requests with bank/customer originator, justification, approver and validity period.

evidence_requirements.name: SP Access Monitoring Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration of monitoring controls (PAM, JIT access, session recording) applied to SP access to customer information.

evidence_requirements.name: SP Access Logs
evidence_requirements.description: Sample SP access logs showing user, action, data accessed and timestamps.

evidence_requirements.name: Periodic SP Access Audit Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic audit reports on SP access to customer information with anomaly investigation.

evidence_requirements.name: Unauthorised Storage/Medium Prevention Controls
evidence_requirements.description: DLP, USB blocking, egress filtering and policy controls preventing transfer of customer information to unauthorised storage or media.

controls.title: Service Provider Disaster Recovery Requirements
controls.description: Service Providers shall have a Disaster Recovery plan aligned with bank's business requirements, different types of DR Sites (Cold/Warm/Hot/Satellite), and IT assets life cycle management documentation.
controls.full_text: Service Providers shall also have: i. A Disaster Recovery (DR) plan and its alignment with bank's business requirements. ii. Different types of Disaster Recovery (DR) Sites: Cold / Warm / Hot / Satellite. iii. Documentation related to IT assets life cycle management.

evidence_requirements.name: SP Disaster Recovery Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Service Provider's Disaster Recovery plan covering scope, RTO/RPO, recovery teams and procedures.

evidence_requirements.name: DR Plan Alignment Memo
evidence_requirements.description: Memo or matrix demonstrating alignment of SP DR plan with bank's business requirements (RTO/RPO).

evidence_requirements.name: SP DR Site Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Inventory of SP DR sites by type (Cold/Warm/Hot/Satellite) with capacity, location and activation procedures.

evidence_requirements.name: SP IT Assets Lifecycle Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: SP-provided documentation covering IT asset acquisition, deployment, maintenance, refresh and disposal lifecycle.

controls.title: Service Provider Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.description: Service Providers shall have a Disaster Recovery (DR) plan aligned with the bank's business requirements.
controls.full_text: A Disaster Recovery (DR) plan and its alignment with bank's business requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: SP Disaster Recovery Plan Document
evidence_requirements.description: Approved Disaster Recovery Plan from the Service Provider covering IB-supporting services.

evidence_requirements.name: DR Plan Alignment Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Side-by-side comparison evidencing alignment of SP DR objectives (RTO/RPO) with the bank's documented business requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: DR Test Reports from SP
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic DR test reports from the SP with results, gaps and corrective actions.

evidence_requirements.name: Joint DR Walkthrough Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of joint DR walkthroughs or table-top exercises between bank and SP.

controls.title: Service Provider Disaster Recovery Sites
controls.description: Service Providers shall have different types of Disaster Recovery (DR) Sites: Cold / Warm / Hot / Satellite.
controls.full_text: Different types of Disaster Recovery (DR) Sites: Cold / Warm / Hot / Satellite.

evidence_requirements.name: DR Site Type Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: SP documentation describing the type and configuration of each DR site (Cold / Warm / Hot / Satellite).

evidence_requirements.name: DR Site Operational Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Operational evidence (site visit reports, photographs, infrastructure inventory) of each DR site.

evidence_requirements.name: Site Activation Procedures
evidence_requirements.description: SP procedures for activating each DR site type with timelines.

evidence_requirements.name: DR Site Geographic Risk Map
evidence_requirements.description: Geographic risk map showing DR site separation against single-event risks (earthquake, flood, power grid).

controls.title: Service Provider IT Assets Life Cycle Management
controls.description: Service Providers shall have documentation related to IT assets life cycle management.
controls.full_text: Documentation related to IT assets life cycle management.

evidence_requirements.name: SP IT Asset Lifecycle Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Service Provider policy governing IT asset lifecycle (acquisition, deployment, operation, refresh, disposal).

evidence_requirements.name: SP IT Asset Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: SP IT asset inventory/CMDB extract for assets supporting the bank's IB services.

evidence_requirements.name: Asset Lifecycle Procedures
evidence_requirements.description: Procedures for each lifecycle stage including secure disposal/sanitisation.

evidence_requirements.name: Lifecycle Audit Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of bank/SP audits validating lifecycle adherence including disposal certificates.

controls.title: Security Controls Monitoring
controls.description: Bank shall develop and implement a formally approved mechanism for monitoring of Security Controls, including an analysis of the effectiveness of existing or proposed monitoring methods.
controls.full_text: Bank shall develop and implement a formally approved mechanism for the monitoring of Security Controls. An analysis of the effectiveness of existing or proposed Security Controls Monitoring methods shall be part of this monitoring mechanism.

evidence_requirements.name: Security Controls Monitoring Mechanism (Formally Approved)
evidence_requirements.description: Formally approved Security Controls Monitoring mechanism document covering scope, methods, roles and reporting.

evidence_requirements.name: Approval Records
evidence_requirements.description: Approval records (senior management / BoD / IT Steering Committee) for the Security Controls Monitoring mechanism.

evidence_requirements.name: Monitoring Method Effectiveness Analysis
evidence_requirements.description: Analysis report on the effectiveness of existing or proposed Security Controls Monitoring methods.

evidence_requirements.name: Monitoring Coverage Map
evidence_requirements.description: Map showing coverage of monitoring methods against each baseline security control area.

controls.title: Network Activity Monitoring
controls.description: The monitoring mechanism shall cover monitoring of bank's network activity by collecting and analyzing host and network data related to security events, such as privileged access to sensitive operating systems, configuration changes, and access to critical applications.
controls.full_text: Monitoring of bank's network activity by collecting and analyzing the host and network data related to security events. Examples of security events include privileged access to sensitive operating systems, configuration changes, and access to critical applications etc.

evidence_requirements.name: SIEM Architecture Document
evidence_requirements.description: SIEM/log analytics architecture covering host and network data sources for IB.

evidence_requirements.name: SIEM Log Source Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Inventory of integrated log sources (host, network, security appliances, applications) feeding the SIEM.

evidence_requirements.name: Privileged Access Monitoring Logs
evidence_requirements.description: Sample logs of privileged access to sensitive operating systems collected by SIEM/PAM.

evidence_requirements.name: Configuration Change Monitoring Logs
evidence_requirements.description: Sample logs of configuration changes detected and forwarded to SIEM.

evidence_requirements.name: Critical Application Access Logs
evidence_requirements.description: Sample access logs from critical IB applications ingested by SIEM.

evidence_requirements.name: Correlation Rule Set Export
evidence_requirements.description: Active SIEM correlation rules covering security events specified in 2.3(a).

controls.title: IDS/IPS Monitoring and Security Breach Response
controls.description: Methods for proactive monitoring of IDS/IPS and for responding to security breaches shall be detailed in the monitoring mechanism. A rapid response team shall be nominated and made responsible to respond immediately in case of a security breach.
controls.full_text: Methods for proactive monitoring of IDS/IPS and for responding to security breaches should be listed in detail in the monitoring mechanism. A rapid response team should be nominated and made responsible to respond immediately in case of a security breach.

evidence_requirements.name: IDS/IPS Monitoring Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Detailed procedure for proactive IDS/IPS monitoring including monitoring frequency, alert tuning and escalation.

evidence_requirements.name: Security Breach Response Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Detailed security breach response procedure with detection, containment, eradication, recovery and lessons-learned phases.

evidence_requirements.name: Rapid Response Team Charter
evidence_requirements.description: Charter of the nominated rapid response team with mission, authorities and immediate-response responsibilities.

evidence_requirements.name: Rapid Response Team Roster
evidence_requirements.description: Roster of rapid response team members (primary, alternates) with on-call rotation and contact details.

evidence_requirements.name: Sample Breach Response Records
evidence_requirements.description: Sample records of breach response activations demonstrating immediate response by the rapid response team.

evidence_requirements.name: IDS/IPS Alert Triage Logs
evidence_requirements.description: Sample IDS/IPS alert triage and disposition logs.

controls.title: Authentication Controls Monitoring and Reporting
controls.description: The monitoring and reporting mechanism for Authentication Controls shall be formally documented and approved by senior management and implemented accordingly.
controls.full_text: Monitoring and reporting mechanism of Authentication Controls should be formally documented and approved by the senior management and implemented accordingly.

evidence_requirements.name: Authentication Monitoring & Reporting Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Formally documented Authentication Controls monitoring and reporting procedure.

evidence_requirements.name: Senior Management Approval
evidence_requirements.description: Senior management approval evidence for the Authentication monitoring & reporting mechanism.

evidence_requirements.name: Authentication Monitoring Dashboards
evidence_requirements.description: Operational dashboards monitoring authentication events (login success/failure, MFA failures, lockouts, anomalies).

evidence_requirements.name: Authentication Monitoring Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic authentication monitoring reports issued under the approved mechanism.

evidence_requirements.name: Authentication Anomaly Alert Logs
evidence_requirements.description: Sample authentication anomaly alert logs and triage records.

controls.title: System Restoration Procedures
controls.description: Procedures and time required for restoration of bank's systems shall be part of the Security Controls Monitoring process.
controls.full_text: Procedures and time required for restoration of bank's systems should be part of Security Controls Monitoring process.

evidence_requirements.name: System Restoration Procedures
evidence_requirements.description: Documented restoration procedures for IB systems with detailed step-by-step recovery actions.

evidence_requirements.name: Restoration RTO Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of agreed restoration times (RTOs) per IB system with last-tested values.

evidence_requirements.name: Restoration Test Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic restoration test reports demonstrating that defined timeframes are achievable.

evidence_requirements.name: Backup & Restore Logs
evidence_requirements.description: Sample backup and restore job logs with completion status and durations.

controls.title: Security Testing
controls.description: The monitoring mechanism shall include use of self-assessments, penetration testing, and independent security audits commensurate with the systems' complexity and risk exposures.
controls.full_text: Use of self-assessments, penetration testing, and independent security audits commensurate with the systems' complexity and risk exposures.

evidence_requirements.name: Annual Security Testing Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Annual security testing plan listing self-assessments, penetration tests and independent audits with scope and timing.

evidence_requirements.name: Self-Assessment Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Latest self-assessment reports for IB systems with control coverage.

evidence_requirements.name: Penetration Test Report
evidence_requirements.description: Latest penetration test reports for IB systems and applications with findings and remediation status.

evidence_requirements.name: Independent Security Audit Report
evidence_requirements.description: Latest independent security audit report covering IB systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Testing Scope Justification
evidence_requirements.description: Justification document showing how testing scope and frequency are commensurate with system complexity and risk.

evidence_requirements.name: Finding Remediation Tracker
evidence_requirements.description: Tracker of findings from all testing activities with severity, owner and closure status.

controls.title: Policy Violation and Unauthorized Configuration Change Identification

controls.title: Details of Established Security Breaches in IB (Quarterly Report Template)
controls.description: Prescribed quarterly reporting format for banks to report established Internet Banking security breaches to the Payment Systems Department, SBP. Includes bank identification, submission details and structured breach information fields.
controls.full_text: Annexure-I: Details of Established Security Breaches in IB. Name of the bank, For the Quarter Ending, Submitted By (Name), Designation and Seal, Contact No. Table columns: Sr., Source of security breach discovery, Nature of security breach, Reasons for the occurrence of security breach (e.g. Breach of controls, Procedures were not followed, weaknesses in implemented security controls etc.), Impact of security breach (e.g. on banks business, systems, customers etc), Action(s) taken to rectify the Security Breaches, Remarks (further details, if any).
